objectives.en: You can move between the points of the cue card with natural transitions instead of 'and then'.
objectives.vi: Bạn chuyển giữa các ý trên cue card bằng từ chuyển tự nhiên thay vì 'and then'.

objectives.en: You can describe a feeling with more than 'happy' or 'sad'.
objectives.vi: Bạn mô tả cảm xúc bằng nhiều hơn 'happy' hay 'sad'.

objectives.en: You can add one sensory detail to each point to fill two minutes without repeating.
objectives.vi: Bạn thêm một chi tiết cảm quan cho mỗi ý để nói đủ hai phút mà không lặp.

body.en: A Part 2 talk at band 5 is a list: *"...and then... and then... and also..."*. At band 6-7 the listener is **told where you are going**: *"The reason I chose this is..."*, *"What made it special was..."*, *"Looking back, ..."*, *"The other thing I remember is..."*. One transition per bullet point on the cue card is enough. They are the Coherence marks in Speaking.
body.vi: Bài Part 2 band 5 là một danh sách: *"...and then... and then... and also..."*. Band 6-7 thì người nghe **được báo bạn đang đi đâu**: *"The reason I chose this is..."*, *"What made it special was..."*, *"Looking back, ..."*, *"The other thing I remember is..."*. Mỗi gạch đầu dòng trên cue card một từ chuyển là đủ. Đó là điểm Coherence trong Nói.

heading.en: Feelings with more than one word
heading.vi: Cảm xúc bằng nhiều hơn một từ

body.en: Every cue card ends with *"and explain how you felt / why it matters"*. *"I was very happy"* earns nothing. Say **the feeling, its strength, and what it did to you**: *"I was relieved, honestly, more than happy: I'd been worrying about it for weeks and suddenly I could sleep."* Learn eight feeling words beyond happy and sad: *relieved, proud, nervous, disappointed, overwhelmed, grateful, embarrassed, curious*.
body.vi: Mọi cue card kết bằng *"and explain how you felt / why it matters"*. *"I was very happy"* không được gì. Hãy nói **cảm xúc, mức độ, và nó làm gì với bạn**: *"I was relieved, honestly, more than happy: I'd been worrying about it for weeks and suddenly I could sleep."* Học tám từ cảm xúc ngoài happy và sad: *relieved, proud, nervous, disappointed, overwhelmed, grateful, embarrassed, curious*.

heading.vi: Mỗi ý một chi tiết cảm quan

body.en: Two minutes feels long when you only have facts. Add **one thing you saw, heard, smelt or touched** to each bullet: *"The office was on the twelfth floor and the windows rattled when the wind blew."* Details are easy to produce because they are memories, not opinions, and they are what makes the talk sound like yours. One per point, not five: you still need to reach the last bullet.
body.vi: Hai phút thấy dài khi bạn chỉ có dữ kiện. Thêm **một thứ bạn thấy, nghe, ngửi hay chạm** cho mỗi gạch đầu dòng: *"The office was on the twelfth floor and the windows rattled when the wind blew."* Chi tiết dễ nói vì là ký ức, không phải ý kiến, và chính chúng làm bài nói giống của bạn. Mỗi ý một chi tiết, không phải năm: bạn vẫn cần tới gạch đầu dòng cuối.

title.en: A Part 2 with transitions, a feeling and details marked
title.vi: Part 2 có đánh dấu từ chuyển, cảm xúc và chi tiết

examples.text:
Cue card: Describe an important decision you made.

"The decision I want to talk about is leaving my first job after only eight months. [TRANSITION] The reason I had to make it was that the company moved to a building an hour and a half away. [DETAIL] I remember the bus was always full and the windows steamed up in winter. [TRANSITION] What made it hard was that I liked my team. [FEELING] At first I felt guilty, almost as if I were letting them down, and for a few weeks I kept checking my old work email. [TRANSITION] Looking back, though, it was a good decision, because the next job was where I learned most of what I can do now."

note.en: Four transitions, one feeling with its strength and effect, one sensory detail. No 'and then'.
note.vi: Bốn từ chuyển, một cảm xúc có mức độ và tác động, một chi tiết cảm quan. Không có 'and then'.
